exact_name_nonheading_hits.text: The Sphere of Dreams cultivates symbols, sleep, subconscious pressure, and lucid passage. Its practitioners plant Dream Seeds, create Dreamscapes, soothe allies, frighten enemies, and walk roads that exist only while the waking world loosens its grip.
A Dream Seed is a symbolic impression planted in one creature’s subconscious.
A Dream Seed is not a visible mark.
a Dream Seed on an awake unwilling creature lasts until the start of your next turn;
a Dream Seed on a willing or sleeping creature lasts for 1 hour;
a creature may bear only one of your Dream Seeds at a time;
a Dream Seed allows you to use Seed talents on that creature;
a Dream Seed ends if a talent consumes it. A sleeping creature does not automatically wake when a Dream Seed is planted.
Apply Dream Seed automatically.
The Dream Seed lasts for 1 hour.

#### Allies - gain Half Cover; - gain Advantage on checks and saving throws against forced movement; - move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks after hitting, once per turn.
